method.mapping: Identity at every stage, retaining 100% of starting word identities and their fixed prior mass.
method.order: 73-book canonical order from archive data.txt; consecutive nonoverlapping chains, not a chronology of language change.
method.counts: Echo1b through4a section token counts; each chain consumes eight disjoint consecutive passages.
method.tokenization: Unicode letter sequences, NFC lowercase; punctuation discarded; no stemming or u/v, i/j or ae/oe folding.
method.shuffled: Three predetermined seeds independently shuffle the complete token multiset; a sampling/finite-vocabulary control, not historical prose.
method.common: Freeze the initial count>=10 word cohort. Common-plus-other TV retains each common word and pools every other word into one bucket. Common-conditional TV renormalizes each section within the frozen common cohort; its observed mass is separately retained.
method.limits: No matching of Latin/Voynich vocabulary size, morphology, genre, or repetition. Cross-book passages allowed and inventoried. Descriptive comparison, not a null threshold or an optimizer result.
